name: std::chrono::zoned_time<Duration,TimeZonePtr>::get_info
intro: Obtains the std::chrono::sys_info containing information about the time zone at the time point stored in *this.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: zone->get_info(tp), where zone is the non-static data member holding the time zone pointer, and tp is the non-static data member holding the stored time point (as a std::chrono::sys_time<duration>).

summary: Obtains the std::chrono::sys_info containing information about the time zone at the time point stored in *this.
